title: Newton's Third Law: Action and Reaction
summary: Forces come in equal and opposite pairs acting on different objects: walking, rowing, recoil and rockets.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 6: How Forces Affect Motion
Earlier NCERT: Force and Laws of Motion

objectives: I can state Newton's third law.
I can identify action-reaction pairs and the objects they act on.
I can explain why paired forces do not cancel.
misconceptions: Action and reaction cancel each other out.
The bigger object exerts the bigger force.
A rocket needs air to push against.
